status: Scratch profiling and cache feasibility; no production optimization promoted or new package exported.
scope: User Windows RTX4090 Mobile report investigated on Linux RTX3090/Forward+/Vulkan. Main thread only. Existing game code, saves and released/local archives are unchanged.
findings: Immutable transition/donor metadata is already retained per map. Most remaining Natural work is per-fragment sampling and relief evaluation.

Main-device compute can bake the actual composed ground sampler, including authored rotations, donor fields and all four traits, without CPU image readback. Each mip is evaluated independently at its isotropic footprint.

A 16x16 tile sector plus one-tile gutter at 48 pixels/tile costs 15924800 logical bytes for two RGBA16F textures, or 11943600 with RGBA8 traits. These figures exclude driver overhead and source atlases.
The compact traits variant changes few additional pixels relative to full precision. The larger errors arise from resolving a position/footprint-dependent nonlinear field into filtered textures.
96 pixels/tile does not monotonically improve reconstruction. 144 improves close-up colour but worsens oblique/distant differences; its compact single sector costs 107494740 logical bytes.
A tile/warped-field boundary mask reduces changed area but does not remove the largest outliers and loses much of the measured saving.
Caching only Natural-minus-original preserves more native sampling, but still retains colour outliers and larger encoded-normal differences. It is not selected for production.

The largest measured cloud path here is the moving High sky. Enhanced water has a separate substantial cloud march even with SSR and sunlight attenuation removed. Low/High water have the same integration budget in the source.

cache_decision.reason: The resolved-colour and delta alternatives have not met a production quality/streaming contract. Do not build map residency around an assumed exact field or claim these measurements as a shipped speedup.
cache_decision.quality_scope: 39/58-check harness totals cover preparation, saved captures, held frames and exact restoration. Image/normal differences are measured, not quality-pass assertions. Means are over the full 1280x720 viewport and include unchanged pixels outside the single cached sector.

failed_trials_retained.natural-cache01: GDScript type inference error before rendering.
failed_trials_retained.natural-quality04: Raw diagnostic shader incorrectly returned from fragment(); shader compilation rejected. Its results are not accepted.
failed_trials_retained.natural-delta10: RD supports SNORM storage, but Texture2DRD image-format bridge rejects it. Renderer errors/leaked temporary renderer texture wrappers invalidate the run. Delta11 encodes signed traits around byte128 in supported UNORM instead.
failed_trials_retained.cloud-path13: Default startup frame cap overrode the fixture; all twelve uncapped checks failed. Corrected fixture records actual cap/vsync in every arm and passes in cloud-path14.

moving_cloud_paths_2560x1440.scope: Isolated normal viewport cost. Sky-only and real enhanced water without SSR or solar attenuation, moving through the identical 1/60 game-clock interval per arm. Diagnostic attribution, not Windows FPS or an optimization.

timing_limits: Measurements are complete diagnostic viewports, not summed components of one game frame and not Windows FPS.
Surface-cost12 and natural-cost09/delta11 observed no other Godot process at either endpoint; this does not control other GPU applications, clocks or thermals.
Cloud-path14 has another rendered Godot process at its start and none at its end. Treat its timings as attribution evidence, not a clean performance acceptance.
Earlier runs with observed foreign rendering remain retained. Do not compare their absolute times to the later runs as an optimization.
Creation CPU time is not GPU bake cost. No per-frame residency implementation or sustained playthrough was timed.

next_work.priority: Continue cloud optimization before further resolved-terrain-cache engineering; current Natural prototypes stay isolated.
next_work.candidate: Prototype a bounded shared 2D cache of the horizontal cloud-weather inputs used by cv_density. Its six repeated 2D noise lookups are common to sky, water and sunlight. Keep vertical density, shape/erosion and scattering live.
next_work.source: game/src/game/fx/cloud_volume.gd: cv_coord, cv_weather and the type_noise lookup at the start of cv_density.
next_work.contract: Compare actual sky/reflection images and moving frames first. Preserve owner/game-clock/pause, native density fallback outside the field and below/above the layer, and option/map cleanup. LUT resolution and filtering are an explicit approximation requiring evidence.
next_work.memory_candidate: RGBA16F without mips at 1024/2048 is 8/32 MiB; one bounded field must cover the sampled horizontal ray/light domain, not an unbounded map bake. This candidate is not implemented.
